name: char-budget
title: Character Budget
description: Counts graphemes against several limits at once (X, SMS segments, LinkedIn, meta description), names the curly quote or emoji that forced UCS-2 SMS encoding, and can swap them for plain characters in one tap.

meta.stops: Post cut off or SMS costs double
meta.summary: Counts text against X, SMS, LinkedIn and meta-description limits at once, so posts aren't cut off and SMS don't silently cost double.
catches: Text over each platform's limit, counted as people see characters (emoji and flags count once)
X's weighting (URLs as 23, emoji and CJK as 2)
Characters that force UCS-2 and shrink an SMS segment from 160 to 70
limits: Platform limits are built in and can change; pass your own targets to override
Falls back to code points where Intl.Segmenter is unavailable
Real SMS cost also depends on the carrier and gateway
a11y: Visible <label>; the field is described by an aria-live="polite" summary
Buttons that find a problem character have aria-labels naming it
Finding a character moves focus to it in the field
